workflow.yaml:
name: real-estate-compliance-llama-3b
nodes:
- id: research
  type: web-research
  needs: []
  inputs:
    queries:
    - Fair Housing Act obligations of real estate agents and landlords
    - RESPA Section 8 kickbacks and referral fees in real estate
    - TILA-RESPA integrated disclosure (TRID) loan estimate and closing disclosure
      timing
    - US state real estate license requirements and continuing education
    - seller property condition disclosure requirements by state
    max_pages: 20
- id: synth
  type: synth-distilabel
  needs:
  - research
  inputs:
    pipeline_template: grounded
    corpus: ${{ nodes.research.outputs.corpus }}
    teacher_model: nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b
    n_samples: 300
    max_usd: 0.5
    max_tokens: 800
    instructions: Questions a US real-estate agent, broker or loan officer asks about
      compliance; answers in at most three sentences, using only the passage.
- id: prep
  type: data-prep
  needs:
  - synth
  inputs:
    dataset: ${{ nodes.synth.outputs.dataset }}
    format: chatml
    train_split: 0.8
    test_split: 0.1
- id: finetune
  type: tf-finetune
  needs:
  - prep
  inputs:
    model: meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct
    train_data: ${{ nodes.prep.outputs.train_jsonl }}
    eval_data: ${{ nodes.prep.outputs.eval_jsonl }}
    n_epochs: 2
- id: serve
  type: vllm-serve
  needs:
  - finetune
  inputs:
    model: meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct
    lora_adapter: ${{ nodes.finetune.outputs.lora_adapter }}
    keep_alive_min: 30
- id: evaluate
  type: judge-eval
  needs:
  - prep
  - serve
  inputs:
    test_data: ${{ nodes.prep.outputs.test_jsonl }}
    base_model_ref: ${{ nodes.serve.outputs.base_model_ref }}
    tuned_model_ref: ${{ nodes.serve.outputs.model_ref }}
    judge_model: nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b
    max_samples: 30

queries: Fair Housing Act obligations of real estate agents and landlords
RESPA Section 8 kickbacks and referral fees in real estate
TILA-RESPA integrated disclosure (TRID) loan estimate and closing disclosure timing
US state real estate license requirements and continuing education
seller property condition disclosure requirements by state
